label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y entraron Moisés y Aarón a tienda de reunión, y salieron y bendijeron al pueblo, y se apareció gloria de Jehová a todo el pueblo.
spanish: Y entraron Moisés y Aarón a tienda de reunión, y salieron y bendijeron al pueblo, y se apareció gloria de Jehová a todo el pueblo.
grammarChanges: Kept the plural verb «entraron» for h03009023001 (וַיָּבֹא, qal sequential imperfect 3ms). Hebrew allows a singular verb before a compound subject (agreement with the first/nearer conjunct), but Spanish requires the finite verb to agree in number with the full compound subject Moisés y Aarón, so a literal singular «entró» would be ungrammatical here; no participant or event changes.
readerNote: Chose the grammatical Spanish plural «entraron» to agree with the compound subject Moisés y Aarón, since Spanish does not allow the singular verb that Hebrew uses before a compound subject; who entered is unchanged.
